versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The NvM High Proxy shall provide the functions for single block requests, according to [SWS_SwCluC_02103], once per configured SwCluCNvMBaseSocket . In doing so, the APIs are provided with the original Mip NvM at the EcucPartition , where the SwCluCNativeBswApi is set to true . For all the other SwCluCNvMBaseSocket instances, the Mip NvM is replaced by NvM_ <shortName of EcucPartition> .
